text:
Hi,
I have found myself in a difficult situation, maybe someone knows about this or has already gone through this: student visa needs renewal but partner visa application is still unanswered. I applied for a partner visa in December 2025 but haven’t heard anything back at all. Now my student visa needs renewal but this is not possible because of my pending partner visa application. Now they tell me to decide between which application I want to follow through (not really a choice at all). I know by law this is not how is is supposed to work but thats how it is. I am planning to go to Misrad Hapanim in TLV with my partner next sunday, I dont really know what to expect… I have heard revoking my partner visa application might effect later reapplication, so I am worried about doing that and staying on my student visa. I am grateful for any input regarding this problem.
